title: Farmalyze
description: Mod for analyzing and calculating farm rates.
body:
# Farmalyze
A farm analysis mod for Minecraft Fabric that measures item throughput of hoppers and containers in real-time.
## How It Works:
1. Press the **Block Key** (default: `V`) while looking at a hopper or container to select it for tracking
   
2. Press the **GUI Key** (default: `C`) to open the settings screen
   
3. Hit **Start Test** — Farmalyze will measure item flow for your configured duration
   
4. View results: items per minute, per hour, and per day
## Features
- **Real-Time Item Tracking** — Measures exact item throughput through hoppers and containers
  
- **Configurable Test Duration** — Slider from 5 seconds to 120 seconds
  
- **SMP Calculator** — Set custom prices per item to see earnings in $/MIN, $/HOUR, $/DAY. 
  
- **Supports shorthand input (1k, 2.5m, 1b)**
  
- **In-World Block Highlighting** — Selected blocks glow so you know what's being tracked
  
- **Rebindable Keybinds** — Change keys directly in the mod's GUI
  
- **Persistent Config** — All settings and prices are saved between sessions
## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
> ⚠️ This mod must be installed on **both client and server** to function.
